3.71 Dynamic Routing
Definition
The routing of signals or PDUs ( definition 3.172) in a gateway can be changed
throughout operation without change of the operation mode of the gateway.
Initiator
WP Gateway
Further
Explanations
Dynamic routing requires the change of routing tables during operation. It is not
intended to use dynamic routing in the gateway.
